## Debased Asrai (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
CE Tiny fey (aquatic)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +6  


**Defense**


**AC** 18, touch 16, flat-footed 14 (+4 Dex, +2 natural, +2 size)  
**hp** 14 (2d6+2)  
**Fort** +1; **Ref** +7; **Will** +4; +4 vs. spells and spell-like abilities cast by good-aligned fey  
**DR** 5/cold iron; **Immune** cold; **SR** 17  
**Weaknesses** water dependent  
**Speed** 20 ft., swim 50 ft.  


**Offense**


**Melee** touch +7 (1d4 cold) or 2 claws +7 (1d3–3 cold)  
**Special Attacks** cold touch, defiling touch (DC 14)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 5th)  

2/day—control water, fog cloud, obscuring mist  

**Spells Known** (CL 5th; melee touch +7; ranged touch +7)  

2nd (5/day)—hideous laughter (DC 14), summon monster II  
1st (7/day)—charm person (DC 13), hypnotism (DC 13), reduce person (DC 13), sleep (DC 13)  
0 (at will)—dancing lights, daze (DC 12), detect magic, ray of frost, resistance, touch of fatigue (DC 12)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 5, **Dex** 18, **Con** 13, **Int** 10, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 17  
**Feats** Eschew Materials, Weapon Finesse  
**Skills** Knowledge (arcana) +5, Knowledge (nature) +5, Perception +6, Sense Motive +6, Spellcraft +5, Stealth +14, Swim +10; Racial Modifiers Knowledge (arcana) and Spellcraft are class skills for asrai  
**Languages** Common, Aquan, Sylvan  
**SQ** anathema  


**Special Abilities**


**Anathema (Su)** A debased fey has been rejected by the purity of nature. Normal plants within 20 feet wither and die if the debased fey remains in proximity for more than 5 minutes. Pure environments such as untouched forests and clear streams and ponds may become spoiled and polluted if the debased fey remains in that environment for more than 1 day.
